information_status: Limited or No Strong Supporting Evidence
analysis_paragraph: There is no medical proof that boiled guava leaves can cure dengue. Dengue is a serious illness that requires proper medical care and monitoring. Some sources mention that guava leaves may have general health benefits, but they are not recognized as a treatment for dengue. Relying only on home remedies can be dangerous and may delay proper treatment.
